goal: Preserve approved Havenline stylized character identity while producing riggable high-quality triangle meshes and 8K authoring texture masters.

tools.name: TripoSR
tools.notes: Primary local triangle-mesh audition. Final 8K texture must be source-projected from approved turnarounds rather than trusting generated detail.

tools.name: LHM++ SMPLX-FREE
tools.licenseClass: Apache-2.0 top-level; pretrained/prior asset rights must be recorded at acquisition
tools.notes: Excellent match for Havenline's existing front/3q/side/back sheets and fits 8GB GPUs. Current official export is Gaussian-splat PLY, not a conventional skinned triangle mesh, so use it as a faithful 3D reference/validation target rather than the Unity shipping character. Prefer SMPLX-FREE variants.

tools.name: Stable Fast 3D
tools.notes: Use only after recording current license eligibility and required notices/attribution.

tools.name: Meshy Free
tools.notes: Free tier is an audition lane. Do not assume latest-model downloads, multiview or 8K are free.

tools.name: UniRig
tools.notes: Inspect/refine predicted skeleton before final skinning, then map to Unity Humanoid.

tools.name: CharacterGen
tools.blocker: Released requirements include NVIDIA nvdiffrast, whose current source license restricts use to non-commercial research/evaluation.

tools.name: TRELLIS.2 native PBR
tools.licenseClass: MIT top-level, blocked native material dependencies
tools.blocker: Native PBR/render pipeline depends on NVIDIA nvdiffrast/nvdiffrec and is hardware-heavy.

tools.name: Hunyuan3D 2.1
tools.blocker: Territory restrictions create global-distribution risk; EU, UK and South Korea are excluded by current license.

tools.name: IDOL
tools.licenseClass: MIT code with externally licensed body-model dependencies
tools.blocker: Official setup requires SMPL-X and FLAME templates; the normal SMPL-X license is non-commercial scientific research unless separate commercial rights are obtained. Official setup also recommends 24GB+ VRAM.

tools.name: SiTH
tools.licenseClass: MIT code with externally licensed SMPL-X dependency
tools.blocker: Official reconstruction pipeline requires SMPL-X body-model files, which are not free for commercial production under the standard SMPL-X license.

tools.name: PSHuman
tools.licenseClass: MIT top-level; borrowed model/dependency rights require separate audit
tools.blocker: Current 768 model requires over 40GB VRAM and the project borrows/reorganizes models from ECON/SIFU; unsuitable for the RTX 3080 production lane until dependencies and a lower-memory release are cleared.

masterTexture.runtimePolicy: derive 4K/2K ASTC variants and keep only visually justified resolution in Android build
masterTexture.rule: An 8192 atlas alone is not native 8K detail. Source fidelity must come from the approved multi-view artwork and controlled rebaking.

acceptance: winter outfit and gear layout preserved
